glossary.definition: (C) As used in division (B) of this section, "political subdivision" includes townships, municipalities, counties, school districts, boards of education, all state and municipal universities, park boards, and any other entity whose ownership of real property would constitute public ownership.
glossary.source_title: Section 5713.081 - Collecting delinquent taxes on publicly owned property.
